phase: Phase C focused local qualification of the corrected (lifetime-economics) Phase B model
role: Bounded qualification of the corrected broker-forced liquidation model over the former March 2020 failure region. It preserves the ordered Stop Out episodes and forced-liquidated basket records so the liquidation sequence is reviewable without the 1.2 MB full results files. The pre-correction Phase B qualification runs (E:\MarketLab\phaseb-march2020\) are superseded and are not qualification evidence for this model.

window.note: Frozen baseline parameter values; only single-anchor-end-date is bounded. Running without the frozen-baseline -RunEvidence contract binding is deliberate: that contract asserts the full 2019-01-01..2026-06-30 window.

runCommand: pwsh -File MarketLab\scripts\run-backtest.ps1 -Configuration Release -AlgorithmTypeName SingleAnchorVNextAlgorithm -AlgorithmLanguage CSharp -AlgorithmLocation MarketLab\src\SingleAnchor\bin\Release\MarketLab.SingleAnchor.dll -DataFolder E:\MarketLab\data\lean\xauusd-dukascopy -OutputRoot E:\MarketLab\phaseb-march2020-correction -Parameters <run-parameters.txt> -AllowMissingData
notCommitted: The full run directories (log.txt, LEAN result packets and storage) stay local outside Git under E:\MarketLab\phaseb-march2020-correction\ because they carry the complete 55.9M-quote run state; their results.json identity is recorded above.
